title: Video by tapewarp.ai
description:
I made this entire vox style animation using Claude.

But the best part? 
I can actually edit everything afterward.

Instead of being stuck with whatever AI generates, I can open the entire animation in InVideo’s timeline editor.

Change the text, adjust the timing, shorten animations, or fix anything that doesn’t look right.

Here’s how it works:
Connect @invideo.io to Claude.
Give Claude a few reference images and describe your idea.
Let Claude create the animation.
Open it in Invideo’s timeline editor and make any changes you want.

You can use this to explain complex topics, create product videos, or tell stories with animations.

And you don’t need to learn complicated animation software.
Comment INVIDEO and I’ll send you the connector!
